subject: Elmwood case narrative — verification & sign-off needed
messages:

Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-05-31T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Elmwood case narrative — draft for verification

Hi Amanda,

Thanks again for agreeing to participate in the customer story. Attached is a first-pass draft of the narrative we pulled together from our interview and usage data (Elmwood_Case_Narrative_v2.docx). Two quick asks: 1) fact-check the technical/impact numbers (tokens/day, % reduction in latency) and 2) confirm the short quote we proposed on page 2 — we highlighted it in yellow.

If legal needs to review, please loop them in; we can hold anything that requires sign-off. Would you prefer to handle edits in the doc or send a few inline redlines by email?

Attachments: Elmwood_Case_Narrative_v2.docx (draft)

Thanks — I really appreciate the team taking the time.

Best,
Soojin

From: Amanda Park <amanda@elmwoodhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Elmwood case narrative — draft for verification

Soojin — thanks for the draft. Overall looks great, appreciate the concise story. I attached a PDF with our redlines (redlines_elmwood_v2.pdf) and included a suggested rewording for the customer quote — we prefer something that ties to outcomes (cost per claim down, faster triage).

Two items for clarification:
- On page 3 you reference "PHI" being centrally cached; our legal team is sensitive to the acronym and asks we use the phrase "patient data" and call out storage constraints more generally (we will not share examples of identifiable records).
- The reduction percentages listed under "results" match our dashboard but want to make sure the timeframe is clear (Q1 2026 vs. 90-day rolling).

I can do inline comments in the doc if you prefer; I included the PDF with our highlights for quick reference. Also copying Bryan (legal) in case he wants to weigh in.

Attachments: redlines_elmwood_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Amanda Park
Director of Analytics
Elmwood Health
amanda@elmwoodhealth.com
(617) 555-0199

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Park <amanda@elmwoodhealth.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-06-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Elmwood case narrative — draft for verification

Amanda — great notes, thanks. We can absolutely switch the wording from "PHI" to "patient data" and will clarify the timeframe on the results section.

I attached a revised draft (Elmwood_Case_Narrative_v3.docx) with the following changes:
- Replaced instances of "PHI" with "patient data" and added a short sentence clarifying we only reference aggregated/hashed signals.
- Updated the results table header to explicitly say "Q1 2026 (90-day rolling avg)".
- Inserted your suggested quote (shown in italics) below — please confirm final wording. Proposed quote: "Redwood helped us reduce average claim triage time by 42% and lowered our per-claim processing cost by 18% in Q1 2026."

If you prefer, I can set up a 20-minute call early next week to run through the redlines and get Bryan's legal questions addressed. Quick question: do you want us to remove the short retention sentence on page 4 entirely or replace with a neutral line about our joint data handling practices?

Attachments: Elmwood_Case_Narrative_v3.docx

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Amanda Park <amanda@elmwoodhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Bryan Muller <bryan.muller@elmwoodhealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-04T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Elmwood case narrative — draft for verification

Thanks, Soojin — the updated draft looks much closer. Bryan from legal will need to confirm the final wording around data handling; I've attached a short note from legal with their initial questions (legal_questions_elmwood.pdf). They typically take ~48 hours.

On the quote: Bryan suggested one small change to avoid comparative language; new suggested quote (from Elmwood): "Working with Redwood, we decreased average claim triage time and materially reduced per-claim processing costs in Q1 2026." Can your team accept that? If so, we'll aim to sign off after legal confirms.

If you want to speed this, I'm available for a 15-minute call tomorrow at 11:00 AM ET.

Attachments: legal_questions_elmwood.pdf

Best,
Amanda
Director of Analytics, Elmwood Health

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-06-07T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Elmwood case narrative — draft for verification

Amanda / Soojin — looping in Legal (Rachel) to speed review on the data language and the quote. Quick internal notes:
- We are fine with removing the specific retention phrasing; we'll replace with a neutral line that says "Elmwood and Redwood maintain customer data per their respective policies and contractual terms."
- We can accept Elmwood's softened quote language above — marketing will use the approved phrasing verbatim.
- Once legal signs off, we'll prepare a final one-page PDF and a DocuSign envelope for an exec-level acknowledgment (not a binding contract).

Rachel — can you confirm the legal team is good with Bryan's redlines? If yes, I'll assemble the final PDF and ping Amanda with the DocuSign link.

Thanks,

Hi Amanda, team — I've reviewed Bryan's redlines and the v3 draft. Legal is comfortable with the following final edits:
- Use "patient data" language throughout; remove retention sentence and replace with neutral contractual reference as Sergio proposed.
- Approve Elmwood's adjusted quote: "Working with Redwood, we decreased average claim triage time and materially reduced per-claim processing costs in Q1 2026."

I've attached the final approved PDF (Elmwood_case_final_approved.pdf) with line-numbered confirmations. Next steps: Soojin/Sergio, please send Amanda the DocuSign envelope (https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345) for her exec to acknowledge the case study and return a signed PDF to marketing. Once we have the signed copy I'll mark the asset as approved for public use and upload to the shared Drive link (https://drive.google.com/elmwood/case-narrative-v3).

Thanks all — nice work on the draft.

Regards,
